show.description: Born billionaire Ajay Khanna is challenged to reform Jagran College’s most notorious class. Facing rebellious students, ego clashes, conspiracies, and a false molestation accusation, Ajay fights with integrity instead of power. His courage and compassion slowly transform enemies into allies, proving that true strength lies in understanding, not dominance.
